question: Walking at the speed of 8 km/hr, a man covers certain distance in 2 hour 30 minutes. Running at a speed of 10 km/hr, the man will cover the same distance in:
solution:

Walking at the speed of 8 km/hr, a man covers certain distance in 2 hour 30 minutes.

Running at a speed of 10 km/hr
